integrity: Analytical arguments cover stated quantifiers; finite computation corroborates selected instances only. Previously published Gaussian-mixture density is credited and not claimed original.
scientific_limitations: Equal-rate nested reset clocks; all-zero initial state; one-coordinate marginal; D,r>0 fixed; no multivariate or heterogeneous-rate front theorem. The finite-time density is prior work; original claim only concerns the exact Wasserstein distance and sharp simultaneous two-metric large-depth profiles. Independent originality validation remains outstanding.
title: A metric-dependent relaxation front in nested Brownian resetting
